question: Where did Brahmo Samaj originate?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Bengal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was a** monotheistic sect of Hinduism.**
 
• The movement began between meetings of Bengalis in **Calcutta** in 1828.
 
• The imortant motive of the Brahmo Samaj was **the worship of the eternal God**.
 
• It was opposed to** priesthood, rituals and sacrifices.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1586dc21244201bb275d9d7887f1103762838385c6a9b023ca15fab9aaa0333.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arya Samaj, **robust improve movement of modern Hinduism**, started in 1875 by **Dayananda Sarasvati.**​ 
 
• Arya Samaj's motive was to **renew the Vedas**, the earliest Hindu scriptures, as revealed truth.
 
• The Arya Samaj had a very notable results on the **emergence of the community as a cohesive one with a self-confident identity. **
